task_completion.description: The agent opens the CT series located at /home/ga/DICOM/studies/chest_ct/ in a medical imaging viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A DICOM viewer (like Horos, Weasis, or a Python-based viewer) is visible showing a chest CT scan.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to an axial slice where the heart diameter appears largest.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewer displays an axial cross-section of the mid-thorax showing the maximum breadth of the heart.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool to determine the maximum transverse cardiac diameter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or caliper tool is visible spanning the widest part of the heart on the axial slice.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool to determine the widest inner thoracic diameter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or caliper tool is visible spanning the internal diameter of the rib cage at its widest point.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the slice with measurements to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/cardiac_analysis.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file save dialog or terminal command confirms the export of the PNG file to the specified path.

task_completion.description: The agent saves a text report containing cardiac width, thoracic width, and CTR to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/cardiac_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the creation of a report with the three required numerical values.

integrity.description: The agent performed measurements using the imaging software's GUI tools rather than just writing a script to generate a report.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with measurement icons or dragging measurement lines on the image.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the values from the task prompt or privileged info without performing the measurement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement values in the final report match the labels/numbers visible on the measurement tools in the GUI.

integrity.description: The agent accessed the specific directory provided in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file explorer or DICOM import dialog shows the path /home/ga/DICOM/studies/chest_ct/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The CT data is located at /home/ga/DICOM/studies/chest_ct/. The agent must calculate the CTR (Cardiothoracic Ratio) as Cardiac Width / Thoracic Width. A valid CTR for this task should generally fall between 0.25 and 0.80 to be considered realistic. The final outputs must be saved exactly to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/cardiac_analysis.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/cardiac_report.txt.
